findings.text: TERMINAL_EXIT_RE re-implements the terminal EXIT-record reader the module already owns at reckon/crew/review.py:2877 (_EXIT_RECORD_LINE_RE); it duplicates rather than extends the owner (adding a capture group to that pattern would serve both callers), and it is the sixth EXIT-record pattern in reckon beside landing_measure.py:94, standing_suite.py:72, promotion_gate.py:55 and reports.py:1544, so the same notation now has one more reader free to drift.

the final base and head arms (58 and 64 passed, gate-base.log and gate-head.log) run only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py plus the node's own test, and neither static-analysis file imports the changed modules, so the done_when's population (the tests that import the changed modules) was measured at 9806f9da8c7844b64329cbabec06fe02934eb9b8 (164/169 passed) but not at the landed code head bda475d2ec6e2300dc06a7bdc3bf6fc4c0a73daa; the sole pre-existing importer that calls the repair verb, tests/test_a_suite_arm_is_repointed_keeping_the_delivered_file.py, records an unreadable log path so the new observation branch returns None and leaves it unchanged, which is why the gap is low-risk rather than a live regression.

the fragment states that all three arms ran on all_debug, but gate-s58-repair.sh runs pytest directly in place with no srun or sbatch and gate-base.log, gate-head.log and gate-negative-control.log carry no partition line, so the partition is a claim the cited logs do not evidence.

item_verdicts.diff: read the six commits bee04f7f..c7d3ad commit by commit; 9806f9da adds the observation and its plumbing, 8ac06e39 records evidence, 48abaa/657b16c record gate revisions and summaries, bda475d adds the one-line failure_count derivation that answers the prior review's blocking finding, and c019aa/c7d3ad record the repair and quote the negative control's summary line whole.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/test_a_repointed_arm_records_its_completion.py covers the two-process union that then lands (lines 118-164), the stopped process left incomplete and named (166-196), the single-process log's own exit status and ids (198-216), an unreadable named log refused (218-231) and the CLI path (233-258), and the manifest records base 58 passed and head 64 passed with EXIT=0 lines; the head population, however, omits the tests that import the changed modules that the done_when names, and the all_debug partition is not in the logs.
item_verdicts.goal: plan section 58 ('A re-pointed suite arm records the completion its new log shows') is delivered: reckon/crew/runs.py:3597 _arm_log_observation re-derives exit status, failure ids, failure count and completed from the log the repair names or the arm recorded, and reckon/crew/review.py:3073 arm_log_observation reads a multi-process log per process-exit header, unions the ids, requires each process's summary and the terminal EXIT record to agree, and names any process that stopped before its summary.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the delivered manifest; it states status complete, the seven commits ending at c7d3ad42e974, the base and head arm commands and logs, a negative control log at gate-negative-control.log, and rubric lines for all six dimensions; its all_debug partition claim is not recorded in any cited gate log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the six declared paths and the five changed paths in the diff; every changed path (docs/evidence/fragments/.../s58.html, reckon/crew/reports.py, reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_a_repointed_arm_records_its_completion.py) is inside them and none lies outside.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_repointed_arm_records_its_completion.py:201 asserts the re-derived count independently of the log the code reads (the log's three FAILED ids versus 0), and gate-negative-control.log shows that assertion failing 0 against 3 with the answering commit reverted.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log (58 passed, EXIT=0) and gate-head.log (64 passed, EXIT=0) carry their revisions, module paths and commands, and gate-negative-control.log fails 1 case with EXIT=1, but the head population omits the importing tests the done_when names and the all_debug partition is not recorded.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/review.py:3073 follows the surrounding gate-log reader idiom, reuses PER_FILE_MARKER_RE and gate_log_failure_ids, and carries no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in its names or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:3534 now derives failure_count with the ids, so all four fields the red-base rule and receipt check read are re-derived from the cited log rather than carried over.
justifications.reuse: arm_log_observation composes the existing gate_log_failure_ids, _gate_log_format and per_file_gate_runs, but reckon/crew/review.py:3041 TERMINAL_EXIT_RE duplicates review.py:2877 _EXIT_RECORD_LINE_RE instead of extending it, which the rubric scores at most 5.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five changed paths sit inside the six declared write paths, with only a one-line node_field reformat in reckon/crew/runs.py:368 carried over from the earlier round.
